newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet, except active for a short period of time around 1:30 pm Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 higher than last week.

Inquiry was good, demand was fairly good. Sales confirmed on 26,500 slaughter steers and 21,100 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 60,100 head confirmed including 19,000 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1075-1300 lbs 68.00; few Select with end choice including cutting bulls 1100-1175 lbs 67.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 975-1175 lbs 68.00, pen
67.00; few celect with end choice 950-1115 lbs 66.50-67.00.
